description: This file defines an interface 'EntitlementConsumptionStrategy' in the 'OrangeHRM\Leave\Entitlement' namespace. It specifies methods related to handling leave entitlement consumption actions such as creation, cancellation, status changes, period changes, and retrieving leave periods and date limits for leave balance calculations. It is part of the leave management plugin in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EntitlementConsumptionStrategy
classes.description: An interface defining methods for managing leave entitlement consumption processes.

methods.name: handleLeaveCreate
methods.description: Handles the creation of a leave entry for an employee, considering entitlements.

methods.name: handleLeaveCancel
methods.description: Handles the cancellation of a leave and updates entitlements accordingly.

methods.name: handleLeavePeriodChange
methods.description: Adjusts entitlement when the leave period dates change.

methods.name: getLeaveWithoutEntitlementDateLimitsForLeaveBalance
methods.description: Retrieves date limits for leave without entitlement calculations within leave balance.

methods.name: getLeavePeriod
methods.description: Returns the leave period for a specific date, employee, and leave type.
